name: tutorial-video-editor
title: 描述一下，完成
description: Tutorial Video Editor — Edit How-To and Tutorial Videos with AI Zoom and Callouts. Twenty minutes of Photoshop walkthrough and you forgot to zoom in on the toolbar for half the steps. Re-recording is not happening. Instead, hand the screencast to the AI and point at the moments that need a closer look. It applies smooth Ken-Burns zooms to the areas you specify, circles clicked buttons with animated highlights, pins numbered step labels in the corner, and attaches a cursor spotlight that follows your mouse so viewers never lose track. Chop the intro ramble. Accelerate the repetitive middle section at double speed with a visible fast-forward badge. Bake in captions for silent desk watchers. Produce a full-length YouTube how-to and a sixty-second Shorts tip from identical source footage. Aimed at software educators narrating screen workflows, DIY creators filming step-by-step builds, cooking channels shooting overhead recipe walkthroughs, and tech reviewers who talk through their process live and clean it up afterward. Supports mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv.
title_en: AI Video Editing — Describe It, Done
